title: Underwater UFO bases
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of Underwater UFO bases, about present at Earth's oceans, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think that's probably the best bet.

plain: A physicist named Kevin Knuth, speaking on a show about suppressed NASA data, talks about the idea that UFOs have bases under Earth's oceans. Asked where such objects might come from or stay, he says that is probably the best bet, which would mean whatever is behind them may be living right here on Earth.
